text:
Situation: Propofol has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-04-10 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 78 months. Corvale General holds 343 vials of the 20 mL presentation at 15.8 vials per day (21.7 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 10 vials at 2 vials per day (5 days on hand). Corvale East holds 43 vials of 20 mL (8.5 days), 64 vials of 100 mL (8.8 days), and 161 vials of 50 mL (21.2 days). Additional General stock includes four lots of 20 mL vials totaling 600 vials with 12.9 to 30.3 days each, and Lakeside holds 17 vials of 50 mL (7.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2020-05-25. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25. The shortage was first posted 2020-04-10.

Our position: Internal transfers can stabilize supply across sites for two weeks. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. is not on FDA's shortage list and represents a viable purchase source.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of 10 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Transfer 28 vials of 10 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Transfer 17 vials of 10 mg/mL, 50 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Transfer 34 vials of 10 mg/mL, 100 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
5. Initiate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or alternative agent substitutions; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
